title: Fourier granularity of a path indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P$ be a path on the Boolean cube with a real output label, and suppose $\mathrm{length}(P)\le k$ for a nonnegative integer $k$. For every integer $z$, the function equal to $z$ on the inputs matching the assignments of $P$ and zero elsewhere has every Fourier coefficient on the sign cube equal to an integer multiple of $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a path on the Boolean cube with real output label
